defaultValue: Use View or F8 to open the SectorPad command hub and choose Controller Setup. F10 also opens the added Luna controller setup menu. Hold View + Menu for two seconds for the fixed recovery dialog. Guide is never used. This mod only adds its own controls and overlays.

Controller Setup Tools can reset a single binding context, device calibration section or comfort section. Comfort resets use SectorPad factory defaults without changing these native Luna fields. Tools marks active resets and offers Use Luna values; editing and saving a field in that section also resumes its Luna values. Binding resets require a 15-second preview confirmation.

fieldDescription: Enable the SectorPad controller input route. Mouse and keyboard remain available. Saving releases held mod input and requires neutral controller input.

Place the modern Console Commands input and log at the top left for controller sessions. Opening it from the SectorPad hub explicitly selects this layout. Native keyboard-only console sessions keep their normal layout.
-1 chooses the first connected controller. Otherwise select SDL slot 0 through 7. Changing devices requires neutral input.
Automatic follows the connected Xbox or Steam Deck style controller. Labels do not change the normalized button map.
Keyboard shortcut for the SectorPad command hub. Default F8. Clear the key to disable the shortcut. Controller hub access is mapped separately.
Keyboard shortcut for the added Luna Controller Setup menu. Default F10. The command hub also provides controller access.
Keyboard shortcut for the SectorPad on-screen keyboard. Default F9. Also available from the command hub.
Change this to a saved profile ID and Save to preview it. Controller Setup lists the exact IDs and offers controller-operated selection. Profiles only become active permanently after confirmation.
Display SectorPad action hints when controller input is active.
Request pause where the game allows it when the active controller disconnects. All mod-held input is always released.
Show local controller, input-owner and context diagnostics. No text entry, save data or reports are uploaded.
Reduce motion in SectorPad-owned overlays.
Allow drag to stay active until a second press or cancel. Context, focus and device changes always release a mod-owned drag.
Scale only SectorPad overlays and labels. Existing game UI is not resized.
Logical screen units per second at full deflection. Floating-point motion uses elapsed real time.
Higher values give finer motion near the center.
Radial deadzone for pointer motion, independent of movement and aim tuning.
Deflection that reaches full pointer speed.
Pointer speed while the precision action is active.
Wheel notches per second at full scroll-stick deflection. Fractional notches are retained within the same owner.
Scroll response is independent of pointer response.
Reverse vertical scrolling without inverting either movement stick.
Logical screen units per second for map panning.
Maximum zoom wheel steps per second. Zoom is separate from ordinary list scrolling.
Seconds before held navigation starts repeating.
Seconds between repeated navigation steps.

defaultValue: Open a game wheel once to discover its commands, then use Controller Setup Wheels. Choose a wheel; A or Enter lifts and places a command, up/down reorders, Y saves, X stages default order, and B discards unsaved changes. Orders are remembered by stable command ID separately for each profile and context. Missing commands keep their saved place when they return.

fieldDescription: Choose larger targets with fewer slots. Extra commands remain available on additional pages.
Hold the wheel binding and release to select. Disable for toggle-open mode with explicit confirm or cancel.
Request pause for SectorPad wheels where the game supports it and restore only a pause owned by SectorPad.
Returning the selector to this center region cancels the choice.
Seconds required to enter a held wheel.
TwinStick separates translation and aim. Directional steers toward the movement stick. Orbital steers relative to a valid selected target.
Maximum world-space aiming distance from the controlled ship. This does not increase weapon range.
Enable for a press-to-toggle shield action. Disable to hold the mapped shield control.
